title: XDC network snapshot
description: Chain head, block time, gas price and epoch progress for Mainnet and Apothem, refreshed every 5 minutes. Read with standard eth_* calls only; the epoch and round come from the block header. History lines (NDJSON) use this shape without the metadata fields.

$schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema for this document.

version.description: Major version of this document's format. Fields are only added within a version.

generated_at.description: When this data was produced. ISO 8601, UTC.

update_interval_seconds.description: How often this document is regenerated.

stale_after_seconds.description: If generated_at is older than this, treat the data as stale (the feed may have stopped).

license.description: SPDX licence identifier for the data.

note.description: Optional remark about this copy of the data.

live_url.description: For hourly copies: the live URL this was copied from.

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID: 50 for Mainnet, 51 for the Apothem testnet.

status.description: ok: everything read. partial: some fields could not be read (see errors). down: no data.

error.description: Why the snapshot failed, when status is down.

rpc_used.description: RPC endpoint the block data came from.

block_time.description: Timestamp of the latest block. ISO 8601, UTC.

avg_block_time_seconds.description: Average seconds per block over the last 100 blocks.

gas_price_wei.description: Current gas price. Exact integer wei as a decimal string (1 XDC = 10^18 wei).

gas_price_gwei.description: Current gas price in gwei (for display).

epoch.description: XDPoS 2.0 epoch progress, from the round in the latest block header. Epochs are 900 rounds; rounds can be skipped, so timings are estimates.

rounds_into_epoch.description: Rounds completed in the current epoch (0-899).

est_seconds_to_next_epoch.description: Estimated seconds until the next epoch starts.
